title: Dryden Wind Turbulence Model (Continuous (+q -r))
text: Generate continuous wind turbulence with Dryden velocity spectra, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Specification} sets Military reference; {Units} sets the wind speed units Metric, {Model type} sets the turbulence model Continuous Dryden, {Wind speed at 6 m defines the low altitude intensity} sets the measured wind speed, {Wind direction at 6 m (degrees clockwise from north)} sets the measured wind direction, {Probability of exceedance of high-altitude intensity} sets the turbulence intensity 10^-2, {Scale length at medium/high altitudes (m)} sets the turbulence scale length, {Wingspan}, {Band limited noise sample time (seconds)} sets the noise sample time, {Random noise seeds} sets the noise seeds and {Turbulence on} sets the turbulence signals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Wind speed units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Model type
params.values: Turbulence model Continuous Dryden (+q -r) (default) | Continuous Von Karman (+q +r) | Continuous Von Karman (-q +r) | Continuous Von Karman (+q -r) | Continuous Dryden (+q +r) | Continuous Dryden (-q +r) | Discrete Dryden (+q -r) | Discrete Dryden (+q +r) | Discrete Dryden (-q +r)

Wind direction at 6 m (degrees clockwise from north)

params.values: Noise seeds [ug vg wg pg] [23341 23342 23343 23344] (default) | four-element vector
